// <auto-generated/>
using System.Collections.Generic;
using ObFramework.Integrated.Config;
using ObFramework.Integrated.GAS.Config;

public sealed class GasConfigCatalog : IConfigCatalog
{
    public IReadOnlyList<ConfigEntry> Entries { get; }

    public GasConfigCatalog(string resourceRoot = "Config")
    {
        var prefix = string.IsNullOrEmpty(resourceRoot) ? "" : resourceRoot.TrimEnd('/') + "/";
        Entries = new ConfigEntry[] {
            new ConfigEntry(typeof(EffectConfig), prefix + "GasEffects.json"),
            new ConfigEntry(typeof(AbilityConfig), prefix + "GasAbilities.json")
        };
    }
}
